To: David Jackson
Date: May 17
Subject: Are there any interesting places?

places in my town. We usually go to the park, but we want to visit
a different place. There is a good zoo in your town, right?
Write soon,
Tom
From: David Jackson
To: Tom Jackson
Date: May 17
Subject: Yes!
Hi Tom,
I am fine! Yes, my town has a zoo. There is a baseball stadium,
too. But they are both closed on Tuesdays. How about the new
museum? I visited there yesterday! After visiting the museum,
bring your friends to my house! Your grandma sometimes makes
chocolate cookies or a cheesecake, but she will make an apple pie
next Tuesday. Let’s try it together!
Keep in touch,
Grandpa

From: Tom Jackson
To: David Jackson
Date: May 17
Subject: Are there any interesting places?
Hi Grandpa,
How are you? Next Tuesday is a school holiday. I want to go
somewhere with my friends. However, I cannot find any interesting
places in my town. We usually go to the park, but we want to visit
a different place. There is a good zoo in your town, right?
Write soon,
Tom
From: David Jackson
To: Tom Jackson
Date: May 17
Subject: Yes!
Hi Tom,
I am fine! Yes, my town has a zoo. There is a baseball stadium,
too. But they are both closed on Tuesdays. How about the new
museum? I visited there yesterday! After visiting the museum,
bring your friends to my house! Your grandma sometimes makes
chocolate cookies or a cheesecake, but she will make an apple pie
next Tuesday. Let’s try it together!
Keep in touch,
Grandpa
